mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_journal_line (id, journal_entry_id, line_no, instruction_line_id, account_id, entry_side, amount, create_time) VALUES (#{line.id}, #{line.journalEntryId}, #{line.lineNo}, #{line.instructionLineId}, #{line.accountId}, #{line.entrySide}, #{line.amount}, #{line.createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT l.line_no, l.account_id, c.account_code, a.owner_type, a.owner_id, a.balance_bucket, l.entry_side, l.amount, il.account_entry_id FROM t_journal_line l JOIN t_instruction_line il ON il.id = l.instruction_line_id JOIN t_ledger_account a ON a.id = l.account_id JOIN t_chart_account c ON c.id = a.chart_account_id WHERE l.journal_entry_id = #{journalEntryId} ORDER BY l.line_no

SELECT t.* FROM ( SELECT c.id chart_account_id, c.normal_side, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.posting_date < #{start} THEN (CASE WHEN l.entry_side = c.normal_side THEN l.amount ELSE -l.amount END) ELSE 0 END), 0) opening_balance, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.posting_date >= #{start} AND l.entry_side = 'DEBIT' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) period_debit, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.posting_date >= #{start} AND l.entry_side = 'CREDIT' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END), 0) period_credit FROM t_journal_line l JOIN t_journal_entry e ON e.id = l.journal_entry_id JOIN t_ledger_account a ON a.id = l.account_id JOIN t_chart_account c ON c.id = a.chart_account_id WHERE e.ledger_book_id = #{ledgerBookId} AND e.journal_sequence <= #{asOfSequence} AND e.posting_date <= #{end} GROUP BY c.id, c.normal_side ) t WHERE t.opening_balance <> 0 OR t.period_debit <> 0 OR t.period_credit <> 0 ORDER BY t.chart_account_id

SELECT a.id account_id, a.chart_account_id, SUM(CASE WHEN l.entry_side = 'DEBIT' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) period_debit, SUM(CASE WHEN l.entry_side = 'CREDIT' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) period_credit FROM t_journal_line l JOIN t_journal_entry e ON e.id = l.journal_entry_id JOIN t_ledger_account a ON a.id = l.account_id JOIN t_chart_account c ON c.id = a.chart_account_id WHERE e.ledger_book_id = #{ledgerBookId} AND e.journal_sequence <= #{asOfSequence} AND e.posting_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND c.account_class IN ('REVENUE', 'EXPENSE') GROUP BY a.id, a.chart_account_id ORDER BY a.id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.entry_side = 'CREDIT' THEN l.amount ELSE -l.amount END), 0) FROM t_journal_line l JOIN t_journal_entry e ON e.id = l.journal_entry_id WHERE l.account_id = #{accountId} AND e.journal_sequence <= #{asOfSequence} AND e.posting_date <= #{end}
